description: This file defines an interface for accessing configuration options related to AWS S3 regional endpoints, including methods to retrieve the endpoints type and output the configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface providing access to S3 regional endpoints configuration options.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the endpoints type for S3 regional endpoints.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
